claims.content: To investigate and resolve customer inquiries related to auctions, including bidding issues, payment problems, and item details.

goal.raw_text: To investigate and resolve customer inquiries related to auctions, including bidding issues, payment problems, and item details.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The Customer Service Representative is logged into the Auction Admin application.
The CSR has access to the 'Customer Inquiries' section of the application.
A customer inquiry has been received via phone, email, or other communication channel.
A customer inquiry is received by the Customer Service Representative via phone, email, or another communication channel.

trigger.raw_text: A customer inquiry is received by the Customer Service Representative via phone, email, or another communication channel.

claims.content: The Customer Service Representative receives a customer inquiry via phone, email, or other communication channel.
The CSR logs into the Auction Admin application and navigates to the 'Customer Inquiries' section.
The CSR searches for the customer's account using their name, email address, or other identifying information.
The CSR reviews the customer's account details, including their bidding history, payment status, and any previous inquiries.
The CSR investigates the specific issue raised by the customer, such as a bidding problem, payment issue, or question about an item.
The CSR uses the available tools and information within the Auction Admin application to resolve the inquiry or gather necessary information to provide a solution.
The CSR communicates the resolution or provides the requested information to the customer.
The CSR documents the interaction and the resolution in the customer's account record.

If the customer inquiry relates to a specific auction item or bid that requires detailed investigation beyond standard account views, the CSR navigates to the 'SKU History Page' to view the product ID, description, image, lot number, and full bidding history including bidder names and amounts.

If the inquiry involves a dispute regarding the final price or winning status of an auction, the CSR accesses the 'Auction Event Profiles' page to review the specific event parameters, such as reserve price settings, bid increments, and soft-close extensions to verify the auction outcome.

If the customer claims they did not receive auction-related emails (e.g., outbid notifications, win notices), the CSR checks the 'Email Sender Instructions' logs or system email queues to verify if the automated emails were successfully generated and sent to the customer's registered email address.

If the inquiry concerns a payment failure or credit card decline after winning an auction, the CSR reviews the 'Checkout Process' logs or payment gateway integration status within the admin system to determine if the error was due to insufficient funds, expired cards, or system connectivity issues.

If the customer requests a change to their shipping address or billing information post-auction but prior to shipment, the CSR navigates to the user management or order management section to update the 'Shipping Address' or 'Billing Address' fields, ensuring the changes are logged in the audit trail.
The customer inquiry has been resolved or the necessary information has been provided to the customer.
The interaction, including the nature of the inquiry and the resolution provided, is documented in the customer's account record within the Auction Admin application.
If applicable, any required updates to the customer's account (e.g., shipping address, billing information) or auction records have been successfully saved.
